text:
```yaml
name: Claude Agent Workflow

on:
  issues:
    types: [opened, assigned]
  pull_request:
    types: [review_requested, commented]
  issue_comment:
    types: [created]

jobs:
  claude-agent:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Run Claude agent
        env:
          ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
        run: npx @claude/agent --repo . --github-token ${{ github.token }} --issue-comment ${{ github.event.comment.body }} --pull-request-comment ${{ github.event.review.body }} --issue-title ${{ github.event.issue.title }} --issue-body ${{ github.event.issue.body }} --pull-request-title ${{ github.event.pull_request.title }} --pull-request-body ${{ github.event.pull_request.body }}
```
